en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large open parade ground flanked by three plain multi‑storey barrack buildings with hipped roofs and regular rows of windows. In the foreground is a gravel or dirt drill field with a curved path; in the distance a few small figures stand near the central building. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, and a red handwritten number "26680" is at the top right.
